 MEDICARE OPEN ENROLLMENT UNDERWAY
 By Woody Gottburg - Oct 28, 2026 1 
 SHARE 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 THE MEDICARE OPEN ENROLLMENT PERIOD IS UNDERWAY FOR MORE THAN 87 THOUSAND IOWANS.
 IOWA INSURANCE DIVISION SPOKESPERSON KRISTEN GRIFFITH SAY YOU SHOULD CHECK YOUR MAIL FOR A NOTICE ON CHANGES.
 https://kscj.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/MEDICARE1.mp3 
 MEDICARE1 OC…….NEED TO TAKE” :14
 THERE ARE TWO SIGNIFICANT CHANGES TO MEDICARE ADVANTAGE PLANS AS WELLMARK WILL NO LONGER OFFER MEDICARE ADVANTAGE PLANS NEXT YEAR AND AETNA IS DISCONTINUING ITS SILVERSCRIPT PRESCRIPTION DRUG PLAN.
 GRIFFITH SAYS THIS MEANS GOING FORWARD NO IOWA MEDICARE ADVANTAGE PLANS WILL COVER THE MAYO CLINIC.
 https://kscj.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/MEDICARE2.mp3 
 MEDICARE2 OC…….WITH THE SUPPLEMENT” :09
 THE MEDICARE OPEN ENROLLMENT PERIOD ENDS DECEMBER 7TH.
